description: One text search across clinics, pharmacies, products, strains, brands and Findabis articles; small misspellings still match. Use it when you do not yet know which kind the question is about, or to turn a name into a slug. Each match carries its kind, slug, page URL and a one-line summary (town, consultation types and first fee for a clinic; delivery and collection for a pharmacy; brand, dose form, THC and CBD for a product; genetics for a strain; country and product count for a brand), enough to say what something is; call the specific tool for more. No stock, per-pharmacy prices or medical information.

query.description: What to look for: a name, brand, strain, town or postcode.

summary.description: One line of public facts: town, services, fees, dose form, strength, genetics or country
